closedLexicalRegionClass.definition: Whole well-formed scalarized Code satisfying current G73 atom/op/block predicate except additionally Region(label,body,next) and LeaveRegion(label); every leave targets an enclosing region in that same Code; unique/well-scoped labels; body and next recursively closed. No other relaxation, including no Symbol/FloatBits, no direct/indirect/tail calls, no closures or opaque helpers. Valid typed ordinary-value ABI and ownership are premises, not inferred from JS syntax.

analysisOnlyJudgment.LeaveRegion: label must be present in current stack

proofSteps.argument: By structural induction, terminal leaves have no after=true facts. LeaveRegion adds (label,false,true). Allowed Lets are not split_op, so cannot elevate facts. Branch concatenates facts. Every nested Region consequently has fact_after=false, so need=false and does not elevate its next. Thus every region is lexical, no thunk/frame is emitted, including nested regions and outer-label leaves.

Empty frame context plus every plan need=false forces ordinary/grouped lexical rendering and labeled break; well-scoped leaves stay inside same JS function. Forward finite BIR tree adds no loop, recursion, call, private-stack effect or scheduler marker. Existing grouped-tag path preserves case failure and remaining-case ordering; it adds labels/switch/break, not private frames.

Use unchanged G73 typed-value premise: literals cannot denote private sentinels; parameters/captures are completed ordinary source values; Copy/Construct/Project/whitelisted helpers preserve it. Region/leave only select control paths, never create/store a pending marker. Callee either returns ordinary value or throws. No claim for forged BIR or host access to private bindings.

Let i be original pre-enter ksp and b=sp-captureCount after unchanged stores. Generic path pushes one continuation; closed callee leaves stacks unchanged and returns ordinary x; split_done pops exactly that frame, sets sp=b, then calls identical k(x,b,td+1). Elided path saves i, obtains same x, sets sp=b and calls identical k. The missing private frame is unobservable to this closed callee.

Same try/catch surrounds both callee and k. On any throw split_abort(i,b) clears installed continuation functions above original i, restores sp and resets pending tail function/count. k may reenter or suspend after the leaf because original k and catch remain. On success both paths enter k with same logical stack depth/base. No removal of catch or conversion of k to a public wrapper is licensed.

Existing emitter passes td+1 to both callee and k, uses exact td<64 guard, retains fallback argument moves and split. A prospective classifier-only admission must keep this unchanged; same arity gate [1,32], no ABI or quantum change.

Do not alter body/region rendering, arguments, capture selection/store/load, value identity or number/order of operations. Region extension changes only eligibility metadata for same eager window. Therefore existing checked affine uses are neither copied nor dropped by the frame optimization; array mutation and construction still occur once on same selected path. This is preservation given well-formed ownership, not an independent affine checker.
